name: trading-desk
description: Asset tracking, deterministic research, sentiment evidence, TESTNET learning-ticket staging, and immutable trade review.

interface.shortDescription: Track and assess markets through deterministic research.
interface.longDescription: A ChatGPT and Codex interface for local asset tracking, completed-candle TA, sourced sentiment evidence, registered buy/sell/nothing signals, optional validation, public market briefs, non-authoritative TESTNET learning-ticket staging, and immutable post-trade review. Credentials, approval, signing, and venue writes remain outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Track ETH and assess whether the registered setup is buy, sell, or nothing.
Record this manual X sentiment sample and analyze ETH.
Run the costed historical validation for the registered candidate.
Stage the exact directional analysis as a bounded TESTNET learning ticket, without approving it.
